description: Intent taxonomy for RoadSoS PS #9 multilingual emergency triage. Labels map raw panic messages to structured emergency intents using BART zero-shot inference. No fine-tuning required for the baseline; XLM-RoBERTa fine-tuning is the upgrade path.

intent_descriptions.emergency_crash: A road traffic collision involving one or more vehicles. May include injuries, entrapment, or hazardous materials.
intent_descriptions.fire_hazard: Active fire, smoke, or fuel leak associated with a vehicle or roadside incident.
intent_descriptions.medical_emergency: Medical crisis on or near a road — cardiac event, seizure, trauma injuries — requiring emergency medical services.
intent_descriptions.vehicle_assistance: Non-injury incident requiring roadside help: flat tyre, dead battery, breakdown, towing.
intent_descriptions.general_help: Unspecified distress call that does not map cleanly to the above categories.
intent_descriptions.unknown: Fallback intent when classifier confidence is below threshold or message is unintelligible.

upgrade_path.notes: Fine-tune on panic_data.json with at least 200 labeled examples. Add Sinhala and Thai transliterations (10-15 examples each) before final evaluation.
